content_zh:
结果现在倒好，这两个无耻的叛徒，将责任都推到了他的头上！
“徒儿，你听我解释，”丘书容尴尬的一笑，他的手都不知道往哪里放，脸上带着刻意的讨好，“我也是出于对你手中丹方的好奇，所以就想要借用一下，等我将这丹方炼会之后我就会还给你。”
“等你炼会丹药？那是不是整个岛屿都会被炸毁？”白颜的脸色很是难看，“而且，这一次，你们让我损失惨重，这笔帐该怎么算？”
郑起与任翼相视一眼之后，趁着丘书容还没有反应过来，一人上去紧紧的按住了他的肩膀，另外一人则立即用最快的速度将丘书容腰间所系着的空间储物袋给摘了下来，笑呵呵的走到白颜的面前。
“徒儿，一人做事一人当，这件事都是老三惹的祸，这储物袋里是老三毕生的家当，我现在就用它来赔偿你的损失。”
丘书容苍老的脸庞顿时就黑了下来，怒声吼道：“郑起，任意，你们这两个叛徒！”
任翼拍了拍丘书容的肩膀：“老三，反正我们就颜儿这么一个宝贝徒弟，我们的早晚都是她的，你又何必为了这些身外之物斤斤计较？你说我说的可对？”
话是这样没错。
但是……
丘书容按捺住滴血的心，狠狠的瞪了眼任翼：“你为什么不将你的储物袋拿出来？”
“犯错的是你，赔偿的自然也是你。”任翼满脸的理所当然，毫不知耻的说道。
白颜用精神力查探了下储物袋，发现在这储物袋内，竟然都是一些极其珍贵的药材，那些药材更是千金难买！
这下，她的神色缓和了下来，笑眯眯的说道：“看在你们的赔偿很有诚意的份上，刚才那张丹方我就交给你们了，顺便，我会将炼制那张丹方的方法交给你们。”
丘书容原先那一脸心疼的模样，随着白颜这话落下之后，他的整双老眼都亮了一下。
“徒儿，你没有在欺骗为师，真的愿意教我们？”
“不过，我最近要离开一段时日，等我回来之后，再教你们炼丹。”白颜的眼眸冷芒乍现。
六年了……
她离开白府，整整六年！也让那些人享受了五年的时光！这一次，她会让曾经伤害过她的人，后悔不及！
几个老头目光一沉，对于宝贝徒儿的过去，他们这些年也逐渐了解清楚。
丘书容沉吟了半响：“我听说，五年前，二皇子妃所诞下一名麟儿，当时，天降异象，万兽朝宗，世人皆是传言，这万兽朝宗是因为二皇子妃之子的缘故，所以，如今的二皇子妃，已是当朝太子妃。”

“徒儿，不是为师不放心你的实力，实则白家的那些人太无耻了，我怕你会被他们恶心到，”任翼也想了片刻，说道，“这样吧，为师派人跟着你回去，要是有人敢欺负你，你直接让人杀了他！有师父给你撑腰，这片大陆你横着行走都没有关系！”

content_en:
It turned out to be good now, these two shameless traitors put all the blame on him!
"Disciple, please listen to my explanation." Qiu Shurong smiled awkwardly. He didn't know where to put his hands, with a deliberately flattering look on his face. "I am also curious about the elixir in your hand, so I want to borrow it. I will return it to you after I refine the elixir."
"Waiting for you to refine the elixir? Will the entire island be blown up?" Bai Yan's face was very ugly. "Besides, this time, you caused me heavy losses. How should I settle the account?"
After Zheng Qi and Ren Yi looked at each other, before Qiu Shurong could react, one person went up and held his shoulders tightly, and the other person immediately took off the space storage bag tied around Qiu Shurong's waist as quickly as possible, and walked up to Bai Yan with a smile.
"Disciple, one person is responsible for one's work. This incident was all caused by the third child. This storage bag contains the lifelong belongings of the third child. I will use it to compensate for your losses now."
Qiu Shurong's old face suddenly darkened, and he roared angrily: "Zheng Qi, do whatever you want, you two traitors!"
Ren Yi patted Qiu Shurong on the shoulder: "Third brother, we only have a precious apprentice like Yan'er anyway. Our life belongs to her sooner or later. Why do you have to worry so much about these external things? Do you think what I said is right?"
That's right.
But...
Qiu Shurong suppressed his bleeding heart and glared at Ren Yi: "Why don't you take out your storage bag?"
"You were the one who made the mistake, and you are the one who must compensate." Ren Yi said with a matter-of-fact look on his face, without any shame.
Bai Yan used her mental power to check the storage bag and found that inside the storage bag, there were actually some extremely precious medicinal materials, and those medicinal materials were even more expensive to buy!
At this time, her expression softened, and she said with a smile: "Because of your sincerity in compensation, I gave you the elixir recipe just now. By the way, I will also give you the method of refining the elixir recipe."
Qiu Shurong originally looked distressed, but after Bai Yan said these words, his whole pair of old eyes lit up.
"Disciple, you are not deceiving me. Are you really willing to teach us?"
"However, I will be away for a while recently. When I come back, I will teach you how to make alchemy." Bai Yan's eyes flashed coldly.
Six years...
It has been six years since she left the White House! It also allowed those people to enjoy their time for five years! This time, she will make those who have hurt her regret it!
The eyes of the several old men darkened. They had gradually learned more about their precious disciple's past over the years.
Qiu Shurong pondered for a long time: "I heard that five years ago, the second prince's concubine gave birth to a Lin'er. At that time, there was a vision from the sky, and the beasts came to the sect. It was rumored by the world that the beasts came to the sect because of the son of the second prince's concubine. Therefore, the second prince's concubine is now the crown prince of the dynasty."
"Disciple, it's not that I don't worry about your strength, but the people in the Bai family are so shameless. I'm afraid you will be disgusted by them." Ren Yi also thought for a moment and said, "Let's do this. I will send someone to follow you back. If anyone dares to bully you, just have him killed! With Master supporting you, it doesn't matter if you walk sideways on this continent!"
